prefeito.comoAssumiu: É vereador e presidente da Câmara Municipal. Assumiu a prefeitura de forma interina em 04/03/2026, depois que o ministro Flávio Dino, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), afastou do cargo o prefeito Dr. Furlan e o vice-prefeito Mário Neto, a pedido da Polícia Federal, numa investigação sobre suspeita de desvio de recursos federais. Em 05/03/2026, Dr. Furlan renunciou ao mandato para disputar a eleição de 2026 para governador do Amapá.
prefeito.comoAssumiu_en: He is a city councilor and the president of the City Council (the city's legislature). He became acting mayor on March 4, 2026, after Justice Flávio Dino of the Federal Supreme Court (STF, Brazil's highest court) suspended Mayor Dr. Furlan and Vice Mayor Mário Neto from office at the request of the Federal Police, in an investigation into suspected misuse of federal funds. On March 5, 2026, Dr. Furlan resigned to run for governor of Amapá state in the 2026 election.
prefeito.nota: Entre 07/10/2026 e 15/10/2026, Pedro DaLua ficou licenciado da prefeitura para disputar a reeleição à presidência da Câmara Municipal (foi reeleito em 13/10/2026). Nesse período, a prefeitura ficou a cargo do juiz Décio José Santos Rufino, designado pelo Tribunal de Justiça do Amapá.
prefeito.nota_en: From October 7 to October 15, 2026, Pedro DaLua was on leave from the mayor's office to run for re-election as president of the City Council (he was re-elected on October 13, 2026). During that period, the city was run by Judge Décio José Santos Rufino, appointed by the Amapá State Court of Justice.
